text: @zuojinxin/dsh-annotation 是面向 DSH Web 的文本批注插件，通过客户端界面扩展接入会话、对话与语言服务。在聊天消息和工作区文件预览中选中文字后可添加批注，形成编号标记并跨回合收集；发送时批注与正文一起进入同一条消息，回复中的编号可悬停查看对应原文和备注。适合需要针对长回复或文件片段逐点提问的 DSH Web 用户。无需额外 API 密钥或外部服务。

@zuojinxin/dsh-annotation lets users annotate selected chat and file preview text. Add notes or markers, send them with a message, and hover numbered reply labels to review quotes and notes. No API key or external service is required.
想给 DSH 回复里的几段文字分别写批注，再让模型逐条回应。
能不能选中工作区文件预览中的内容，并把备注和问题一起发出去？
I want numbered notes on selected chat text that I can review while reading the reply.
@zuojinxin/dsh-annotation 的功能「选区批注」：在 DSH 对话或文件预览中选中文字后显示操作栏，可写备注或仅标记原文；已保存的批注显示编号标记，并可悬停查看内容。
@zuojinxin/dsh-annotation 的功能「批注随消息发送」：在输入框按 Enter 时将已收集的批注块拼入草稿，和用户正文一并提交；回复中的 Annotation 编号会变成悬停芯片，展示对应原文及备注。
@zuojinxin/dsh-annotation 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 7 天；提交数 144；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

@zuojinxin/dsh-annotation README · 功能：- **选中即批注**：选中助手正文（或工作区文件预览里的文字），工具条点「批注」写备注；留空也能保存，等于标出位置而不写意见。
- **编号角标**：蓝色编号角标贴着原文，滚动时跟随正文、靠近视口边缘自动避让；悬停角标会点亮原文并显示这条批注。
- **跨回合收集**：可以在任意多条消息、多个回合里持续追加批注，统一从 1 编号。
- **待发标签**：输入框旁出现 `N 条批注`，悬停列出全部待发批注，可逐条删除。
- **回车即发**：批注块与你输入的问题一起发出，模型拿到完整批注块。
- **气泡干净**：发送后用户气泡只留你的问题加标签，批注块在浏览器绘制前就被摘掉；刷新历史也会自愈。
- **逐条对照回复**：消息里带上格式约束，模型按 `Annotation 1: …` 到 `Annotation N: …` 回答，回复里的编号变成可悬停芯片，回看原文与批注。
- **文件批注**：侧边栏文件预览（Markdown、纯文本、代码）走同一套流程，引用带文件路径，角标刷新后恢复，同一句话出现在两个文件里也不会串。

@zuojinxin/dsh-annotation README · 交互流：```
选中文字 ──▶ 工具条「批注」──▶ 写备注或留空 ──▶ 高亮 + 编号角标
    ▲                                              │
    └──────── 任意条数，跨回合追加 ◀───────────────┘
                       │

@zuojinxin/dsh-annotation README · 安装：```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add 'github:zuojinxin/dsh-annotation'
```

装完重启 DSH 桌面版生效。

@zuojinxin/dsh-annotation README · 说明：- 面向 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.1。**只在 0.2.2-rc.1 上完整验证过，更早版本不保证兼容。** 插件靠宿主 CSS 类名与 DOM 结构定位，DSH 升级后可能需要适配。
- 支持批注助手回复、**你自己发的消息**（含运行中插话的消息）与工作区文件预览里的文字；PDF、图片、iframe 内的 HTML 不在范围内。
- 选中助手正文时，批注工具条会接管宿主自带的引用浮层，只留一个入口。
- 界面文案与批注协议跟随宿主 `locale`（中文 / 英文，可运行时切换）。
- 待发批注存在浏览器 `localStorage`，换浏览器或清站点数据会丢。
- 禁用插件后，页面上由它添加的元素和样式会全部移除。

@zuojinxin/dsh-annotation README · 开发：```bash
npm test                  # jsdom 单元测试
node --check client.js    # 浏览器端是手写文件，不是构建产物
node docs/render-demo.mjs # 重制动图与截图（无头 Edge + ffmpeg）
```

`docs/preview.html` 是录制源：它把 `client.js` 原样注入一个手工搭的宿主外壳，把时间轴暴露成 `window.demoFrame(t)`，录制脚本据此逐帧断言画面状态，而不是只看图觉得对。

浏览器级检查（`test/overlay-browser.mjs`、`test/sidebar-browser.mjs`）需要 Playwright：把 `PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE` 指向已有的 `playwright-core/index.mjs`。

@zuojinxin/dsh-annotation README · dsh-annotation：> The animation and stills are captured from the [anonymous preview page](https://github.com/zuojinxin/dsh-annotation/blob/main/docs/preview.html), which runs the real plugin against invented data — no session, account or workspace name from any real conversation.

@zuojinxin/dsh-annotation README · What it does：- **Annotate on selection** — select assistant text (or text in a workspace file preview), pick 批注 in the toolbar, write the note. Leaving it empty marks the passage without a comment.
- **Numbered markers** — a blue index number anchors to the passage, stays put while you scroll and dodges collisions; hovering it lights the passage up and shows your note.
- **Collect across turns** — annotations pile up from any number of messages and turns, numbered from 1.
- **Pending tag** — a `N 条批注` tag next to the composer lists every pending annotation on hover and deletes them one by one.
- **Send with Enter** — the annotation block goes out together with whatever you typed. The model receives the full block.
- **Clean user bubble** — the block is stripped from the bubble before the browser paints, so your own message shows only your question plus the tag; a reload repairs history too.
- **Numbered reply** — the message carries a format instruction, and the model answers `Annotation 1: …` through `Annotation N: …`; each label in the reply becomes a hoverable chip showing the quoted passage and your note.
- **File annotations** — the same flow

@zuojinxin/dsh-annotation README · Flow：```
select text ──▶ toolbar 批注 ──▶ write or leave empty ──▶ highlight + index number
      ▲                                                          │
      └───────────── any number, across turns ◀──────────────────┘
                          │

@zuojinxin/dsh-annotation README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add 'github:zuojinxin/dsh-annotation'
```

Restart the DSH desktop app to load it.

@zuojinxin/dsh-annotation README · Notes：- Built for DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.3 (desktop). The plugin locates the host by CSS classes and DOM structure, so a host upgrade may need a matching update.
- PDF, images and HTML inside an iframe are out of scope; text in the file preview and in chat messages is in scope.
- While the toolbar is open on an assistant passage it takes over the host's own text-quote overlay, so there is only one entry point.
- UI strings and the annotation protocol follow the host `locale` (Chinese / English, switchable at runtime).
- Pending annotations live in browser `localStorage`; clearing site data or switching browsers drops them.
- Disabling the plugin removes every element and style it added.

@zuojinxin/dsh-annotation README · Development：```bash
npm test                  # jsdom unit tests
node --check client.js    # the browser bundle is hand-written, not built
node docs/render-demo.mjs # re-render the animation and screenshots (headless Edge + ffmpeg)
```

`docs/preview.html` is the capture source: it injects `client.js` verbatim into a hand-made host shell and exposes the timeline as `window.demoFrame(t)`, so the render script can assert on what each frame shows instead of trusting the picture.

@zuojinxin/dsh-annotation README · Development：The browser-level checks (`test/overlay-browser.mjs`, `test/sidebar-browser.mjs`) need a Playwright installation: point `PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE` at an existing `playwright-core/index.mjs`.
